decisions.reason: After surviving its first year and gaining a dedicated page, this close-to-core identity offering likely meets minimum aspiration levels, so with some organisational slack we would keep it while learning more about demand.

Its limited visibility suggests more uncertain results, but as a strategically complementary development framework near the core business we would keep it for now unless results fall clearly below aspiration.
Its stronger 2024 presentation and very tight fit with enterprise GIS integration indicate results likely at or above aspiration relative to comparable firms, so we would keep it.
As a new workshop built on existing consulting and training capabilities, it is low-cost to carry and useful for exploring customer needs, so we would keep it through another year.
